learnerSourceCheck.prompt: A fraction equal in size to 1/2 is written using four equal parts. What fraction?

supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Identify equivalent fractions. Understand two fractions as equivalent if they are the same size and the parts refer to the same whole.
teachingSteps: Identify the whole and divide it into equal parts.
Represent the fraction with a number line or equal-area drawing.
Explain the unit fractions, position, equality or comparison.
